entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I have a jersey. I think I need to send it back. I'm a bit lost with the website.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to be clear, is it a technical fault with the item or a matter of preference? What specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's not broken or anything. I just ordered the wrong size. It's way too tight in the arms and shoulders. I was hoping I could exchange it for a bigger one.
Okay, that's no problem at all. An exchange for a different size is definitely something we can handle. Do you have your order number handy?
Umm, I don't know. The emails are so confusing. Can't you just help me? I'm not very good with all this online stuff.
Of course. I can look it up with your name and email address. One moment please... Okay, I see your order from about two months ago for the Aero Pro Jersey. Is that the one?
Yes, that sounds right. Is it too late? I know I've had it for a while.
Not at all. I see you're well within our 90-day return window. I've just approved the return in our system. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now so you can send the jersey back to us.
Absolutely. And since you're a VIP member and to make this easier for you, I'll go ahead and place the order for the new size right now with complimentary expedited shipping. How does that sound?
Wow, that's wonderful! Thank you so much, David. That's a huge help. I was so worried about this.
It's my pleasure. You should see the return label and the new order confirmation in your email inbox within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been great. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
